title: Comparison of $4,000 boutique audio cable to $7 Amazon Basics cable shows audiophiles waste a lot of money — scientific audio equipment analysis with analyzer shows no difference in quality | Tom's Hardware
summary: The article compares a high-end $4,000 Kimber Kable cable with a $7 Amazon Basics RCA cable, examining their market positioning, physical features, and scientific audio analysis, concluding that the price difference may not justify the perceived superiority in audio quality.
sentiment_reason: The analysis suggests that while there is a significant price difference, the scientific testing shows minimal distortion in audio quality, implying that the higher cost of the Kimber cable may not be justified for the average consumer.
